lines: Time stops for the world... but not for *you*.
Today you froze a whole afternoon, just to finish your homework in peace. It took you six hours. Everyone else saw... *one second*.
That night, in the mirror, you spot something. One silver hair. You are *fifteen*.
Bea hugs you and whispers: you look tired. You laugh. But you count it up... that is a whole *week* nobody saw you live.
So how many days of your life... have you already spent *alone*, in a frozen world?
Follow and comment... for part three!
